gameModal.descriptionShort: Afesis is a suspense visual novel for young adults where Christian tradition comes alive. Decipher biblical passages, face the shadows that threaten faith and feel the weight of every choice.
gameModal.descriptionFull: While other Christian video games advocate offering an experience dedicated to the believing audience, taking Bible stories as their own to tell in their games, Afesis seeks not only to approach this Christian audience, but also attempts to attract a general audience who loves narrative games. It does this by adopting a current plot, wrapped in the message of Christian forgiveness. You don't need to know Christianity or practice it to enjoy the game, but for Christians this game is an Ode to their Faith. The game offers an enriching experience that highlights Christian values, the danger of addictions, how poor management of these can negatively impact not only yourself but your surroundings, and how God can help us redirect our lives.
gameModal.storyDesc: This story is about how God's forgiveness is what frees human beings from sin and allows them to move forward in life and achieve happiness through love. We play as Dimas, who, now a full adult barely getting by on his own, has been discontented with his life for a long time. He lives in a small family apartment near the Durán & Sons Hardware Store. When his mother, due to wounds from the past, doesn't want her son around and desperately gives him an ultimatum, Gestas appears. Our older brother proposes we commit a crime taking advantage of the precarious situation: together we will steal a Relic from the Durán Family and share the wealth. While Gestas enjoys this lifestyle, we will soon feel the weariness of someone who lets themselves be dragged by their impulses. And once that false sense of freedom is lost, we will try to make amends for our mistakes. But to choose good, you must know it.
gameModal.feature1Desc: Explore the daily life of this family during dawn, midday, afternoon, and night. Attend (or not) events and explore the village of Valdejara.
gameModal.feature2Desc: Juggling work, rest, and vices is something many can understand. As Dimas, you must delve into the complicated dependencies that make you who you want or don't want to be.
gameModal.feature3Desc: At Durán & Sons Hardware Store there are many gadgets at your disposal, but your most valuable resource will always be your ingenuity. Craft like Dimas, charge your clients (or scam them) and fix locks like the handyman you are.
gameModal.feature4Desc: Life in Valdejara is more enjoyable with company, but not everyone is good or wants to socialize. Perhaps there's an alternative Dulcinea waiting for you, a big-hearted and muscular butcher, or a shopkeeper with an interesting accent and a bit suspicious, with whom to spend the afternoon in the village.

about.title: We Are Aftos Studio
about.subtitle: An independent game studio born from the passion of creating experiences that leave a mark.
about.missionDesc: We want to give young people and adults a new perspective with which to focus their lives and their context. And what better way than through focused entertainment with values. Using a current and expressive medium to transmit our ideas, to create a deep emotional footprint. Following Christian ideas and values, we can help young people understand personal concepts or situations through the hand of fantasy.
about.visionTitle: Making our mark in the Indie industry
about.visionDesc: Young creators deserve an opportunity to create and transmit new ideas, especially in this increasingly crowded industry. Our goal is to establish ourselves as an independent studio that gives opportunities to new creators. A studio that opens its doors to young people and their ideas, always following the Christian path, but open to anyone and what they can contribute to others.
about.value1Desc: We believe in new creatives and new ideas, we are proactive and serious about our goal of bringing a breath of fresh air to current entertainment.
about.value2Desc: Our goal is to bring young people the ideas of forgiveness, love and charity embodied in Jesus Christ. We are honest about our evangelizing objective, but we don't seek to create propaganda; we want to tell stories that help understand life and what happens to us from the teachings of Christianity.
about.value3Desc: We want to propose ideas from a different and current perspective. We deal with deep and (possibly) somewhat controversial topics, but always from a position of respect and trying to avoid confrontation. Both our team and our creative objective are diverse and open, and we actively work on developing a product with a universal language that everyone can enjoy.
